summary: Candidate is a distinct session_skill for ProcessPoolExecutor initialization with per-worker setup and BrokenProcessPool error handling. It differs semantically and operationally from peer ThreadPoolExecutor skills (which target I/O-bound work and lack initializer/BrokenProcessPool semantics) and from existing Maven/JavaScript skills (different domain entirely). No existing skill covers process pool initialization with initializer callbacks and broken pool recovery. Peer candidates are ThreadPoolExecutor variants in the same task_family but different method_family and execution model.
